scenes.caption: Skin Soothing Hydrating Lotion
scenes.say: Meet the Dermalogica Skin Soothing Hydrating Lotion. It is a lightweight moisturizer for dehydrated, breakout-irritated skin.

scenes.caption: Relief from dryness
scenes.say: The sheer, easy-to-apply formula helps soothe discomfort and hydrate areas that feel dry. It also helps relieve the dryness often associated with some acne treatments.

scenes.caption: Squalane + hyaluronic acid
scenes.say: Plant-based squalane softens and nourishes, and hyaluronic acid provides instant relief from skin dehydration.

scenes.caption: Ginger, orange, grapefruit
scenes.say: Gentle botanicals, including ginger, orange and grapefruit, soothe the skin. It is recommended for all skin types, including acne-prone and sensitive skin.

scenes.caption: Face and neck, day and night
scenes.say: To use it, apply over your entire face and neck, day and night. The link is in the description.

items.title: How to Use Dermalogica Daily Glycolic Cleanser (Glycolic Acid) #shorts
items.lead: Dermalogica Daily Glycolic Cleanser: a brightening and conditioning cleanser that renews dull, uneven skin tone, best for normal, combination and oily skin.
items.hook: The Dermalogica Daily Glycolic Cleanser: what it does and how to use it.
facts: Brightening and conditioning cleanser that renews dull, uneven skin tone and helps remove buildup
Glycolic acid brightens by loosening dulling dead skin cells
Calendula extract and jojoba seed oil help condition and replenish skin while maintaining its lipid barrier
Best for normal, combination and oily skin
Massage onto dampened face and neck, rinse with warm water; not for use over or around the eyes

scenes.caption: Daily Glycolic Cleanser
scenes.say: This is the Dermalogica Daily Glycolic Cleanser, a brightening and conditioning cleanser for dull, uneven skin tone.

scenes.caption: Glycolic acid
scenes.say: Glycolic acid brightens by loosening dulling dead skin cells, for radiant, healthy-looking skin. It also helps remove buildup caused by environmental factors.

scenes.caption: Calendula + jojoba oil
scenes.say: Soothing calendula extract and nourishing jojoba seed oil help condition and replenish the skin, while maintaining its lipid barrier.

scenes.caption: Normal, combination, oily
scenes.say: It is best for normal, combination and oily skin. To use it, massage onto a dampened face and neck, then rinse with warm water.

scenes.caption: Keep away from eyes
scenes.say: Do not use it over or around the eyes. If your skin is drier, follow with hydrating products. The link is in the description.

items.title: How to Use Dermalogica PreCleanse (Cleansing Oil for Acne-Prone Skin) #shorts
items.lead: Dermalogica PreCleanse: a deep-cleansing oil that melts away excess oil, sunscreen and makeup, recommended for all skin types, including acne-prone skin and skin with visible pores.
items.hook: The Dermalogica PreCleanse: what it does and how to use it.
facts: Deep-cleansing oil that melts impurities and makeup from skin; the first step of the Double Cleanse
Removes excess sebum, sunscreen, waterproof makeup and pollutants without clogging pores
Borage seed, kukui, apricot, rice bran and vitamin E oils condition the skin
Recommended for all skin types, including acne-prone skin and skin with visible pores
Massage over dry face with dry hands, add water to emulsify, rinse, then follow with your cleanser

scenes.caption: PreCleanse cleansing oil
scenes.say: Meet Dermalogica PreCleanse, a deep-cleansing oil that melts impurities and makeup from skin. It is step one of the Double Cleanse.

scenes.caption: Oil, sunscreen, makeup
scenes.say: It melts away excess oil, sunscreen, waterproof makeup, pollutants and leftover products, and it removes oils without clogging pores.

scenes.caption: For acne-prone skin too
scenes.say: It is recommended for all skin types, including acne-prone skin and skin with visible pores, and it is suitable even for oily skin.

scenes.caption: Dry hands, dry face
scenes.say: To use it, massage it over a dry face with dry hands. Concentrate on areas of congestion.

scenes.caption: Add water, then cleanse
scenes.say: Then wet your hands to make a light, milky emulsion, rinse with lukewarm water, and follow with your Dermalogica cleanser. The link is in the description.

items.title: How to Use Dermalogica Skin Resurfacing Cleanser (Lactic Acid) #shorts
items.lead: Dermalogica Skin Resurfacing Cleanser: a two-in-one exfoliating cleanser with lactic acid that helps retexturize skin, recommended for all skin types.
items.hook: The Dermalogica Skin Resurfacing Cleanser: what it does and how to use it.
facts: Dual-action, two-in-one cleanser and exfoliant
Lactic acid concentrate removes dulling surface debris and helps accelerate cell turnover
Antioxidants condition skin; rose flower oil refreshes the senses
Recommended for all skin types; addresses dullness, fine lines and uneven texture
After PreCleanse, lather and massage onto damp face and throat for at least 30 seconds, avoiding the eyes

scenes.caption: Skin Resurfacing Cleanser
scenes.say: This is the Dermalogica Skin Resurfacing Cleanser, a two-in-one cleanser and exfoliant.

scenes.caption: Lactic acid
scenes.say: Lactic acid concentrate helps retexturize skin by removing dulling surface debris and helping to accelerate skin cell turnover.

scenes.caption: Antioxidants + rose oil
scenes.say: Antioxidants condition the skin, while rose flower oil refreshes the senses. It is recommended for all skin types.

scenes.caption: Morning and evening
scenes.say: To use it, apply after PreCleanse. Lightly lather it in your hands and apply to a damp face and throat, morning and evening.

scenes.caption: 30 seconds, avoid eyes
scenes.say: Massage with light, upward strokes for at least thirty seconds, avoiding the eye area. If sensitivity develops, reduce to once a day. The link is in the description.

items.title: Dermalogica Daily Microfoliant Review: Rice Enzymes + Salicylic Acid, How to Use It
items.lead: Dermalogica Daily Microfoliant: a rice-based exfoliating powder for brighter, smoother skin, recommended for all skin types and gentle enough for daily use.
items.hook: A full look at the Dermalogica Daily Microfoliant.
facts: Rice-based exfoliating powder that activates on contact with water
Releases papain, salicylic acid and rice enzymes to polish skin
Skin Brightening Complex of phytic acid from rice bran, white tea and licorice helps balance uneven skin tone
Colloidal oatmeal and allantoin help calm skin
Mix half a teaspoon with water into a paste, massage for one minute avoiding the eyes, rinse; adjust frequency if irritation occurs

scenes.caption: Daily Microfoliant
scenes.say: This is the Dermalogica Daily Microfoliant. In the next few minutes, we will go through what it does, what is inside, and exactly how to use it.

scenes.caption: Exfoliating powder
scenes.say: It is an exfoliating powder, made to help you achieve brighter, smoother skin every day. It removes dulling surface debris and evens skin tone, and it is gentle enough for daily use.

scenes.caption: Brighter, smoother skin
scenes.say: The idea is simple. It removes the dulling debris that sits on the surface, so skin looks brighter and feels smoother, and because it is gentle, you can make it part of your daily routine.

scenes.caption: Activates with water
scenes.say: The rice-based powder is rich in alpha hydroxy acids, and it activates on contact with water.

scenes.caption: Papain + salicylic acid
scenes.say: When it does, it releases papain, salicylic acid and rice bran, to polish skin to perfection.

scenes.caption: Skin Brightening Complex
scenes.say: There is also a Skin Brightening Complex, made of phytic acid from rice bran, white tea, and licorice. It helps balance uneven skin tone.

scenes.caption: Oatmeal + allantoin
scenes.say: And a soothing blend of colloidal oatmeal and allantoin helps calm the skin.

scenes.caption: Exfoliate and soothe
scenes.say: So in one step, you get enzymes and acids that polish, a complex that targets uneven tone, and ingredients that calm the skin while it exfoliates.

scenes.caption: Blemishes + blackheads
scenes.say: It is recommended for all skin types. It is commonly used for dullness, uneven texture and uneven skin tone, and it is also recommended for blemishes and blackheads.

scenes.caption: Half a teaspoon
scenes.say: Here is how to use it. Dispense about half a teaspoon into very wet hands.

scenes.caption: Make a creamy paste
scenes.say: Rub your hands together to create a creamy paste.

scenes.caption: Circular motions, 1 minute
scenes.say: Apply it to your face in circular motions, avoiding the eye area. Massage gently for one minute, then rinse thoroughly.

scenes.caption: Foaming technique
scenes.say: There is also a foaming technique. Pour half a teaspoon of powder into your hand and add water. Rub your hands together until it turns foamy, then massage it onto your face for one minute in circular motions, and rinse off with water.

scenes.caption: Follow with toner
scenes.say: Follow with a toner, like Multi-Active Toner or UltraCalming Mist, and your Dermalogica moisturizer.

scenes.caption: Adjust if irritated
scenes.say: If you experience irritation, adjust how often you use it. And for the full ingredient list, check the packaging. The link is in the description.

items.title: Dermalogica Daily Superfoliant Review: Binchotan Charcoal + Niacinamide, How to Use It
items.lead: Dermalogica Daily Superfoliant: a resurfacing, anti-pollution powder exfoliant with binchotan charcoal, best for normal, combination and oily skin.
items.hook: A full look at the Dermalogica Daily Superfoliant.
facts: Resurfacing, anti-pollution powder exfoliant that activates on contact with water
Releases enzymes, skin-smoothing alpha hydroxy acids and anti-pollution technology
Activated binchotan charcoal purifies skin and helps adsorb environmental toxins from pores
Niacinamide, red algae and tara fruit extract help guard against the effects of pollution
Best for normal, combination and oily skin; for sensitive skin, use on alternate days; not ideal for very sensitive or compromised skin

scenes.caption: Daily Superfoliant
scenes.say: This is the Dermalogica Daily Superfoliant. Let us go through what it does, what is inside, who it is for, and how to use it.

scenes.caption: Resurfacing powder
scenes.say: It is a resurfacing, anti-pollution powder exfoliant. It resurfaces and deep cleanses, and it helps fight environmental triggers known to accelerate skin aging.

scenes.caption: Smoothest skin
scenes.say: This is a highly active resurfacer, made to deliver your smoothest skin ever. It adsorbs environmental pollutants, and it helps detoxify the pores.

scenes.caption: Enzymes + AHAs
scenes.say: The powder activates on contact with water, releasing enzymes, skin-smoothing alpha hydroxy acids, and anti-pollution technology.

scenes.caption: Binchotan charcoal
scenes.say: Activated binchotan charcoal purifies the skin, helping to adsorb environmental toxins from deep within the pores.

scenes.caption: Niacinamide + red algae
scenes.say: Niacinamide, red algae and tara fruit extract help guard against the damaging effects of pollution.

scenes.caption: Papain + lactic acid
scenes.say: Looking at the ingredient list, you will also find enzymes like papain, lipase and subtilisin, along with malic acid, lactic acid and rice bran extract.

scenes.caption: Ginger, lavender, rosemary
scenes.say: The list also includes botanical oils and extracts, such as ginger root, lavender, rosemary, sage, and lemon peel.

scenes.caption: Normal, combination, oily
scenes.say: It is best for normal, combination and oily skin. It addresses dullness, enlarged pores, uneven texture and fine lines.

scenes.caption: After cleansing
scenes.say: Here is how to use it. After cleansing, dispense about half a teaspoon into very wet hands.

scenes.caption: Make a creamy paste
scenes.say: Rub your hands together to create a creamy paste.

scenes.caption: Circular motions, 1 minute
scenes.say: Apply it to your face in circular motions, avoiding the eye area. Massage gently for one minute, then rinse thoroughly with warm water.

scenes.caption: Use daily
scenes.say: It is made to be used daily.

scenes.caption: Daily routine
scenes.say: It resurfaces and deep cleanses in one step, and it is designed to be used every day, right after cleansing.

scenes.caption: Sensitive? Alternate days
scenes.say: If your skin is more sensitive, apply it on alternate days until your skin gets used to it.

scenes.caption: Patch test first
scenes.say: It is not ideal for very sensitive or compromised skin. Do a patch test, and use it less often if irritation occurs. The link is in the description.
